def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    ones = [(r, c) for r in range(height) for c in range(width)
            if grid[r][c] == 1]
    if len(ones) < 2:
        return out

    # Follow the genuine seed diagonal, not an isolated decoy.
    diagonal = [p for p in ones if p[0] == p[1]]
    if diagonal:
        r, c = max(diagonal)
    else:
        ones.sort()
        r, c = ones[-1]
    dr = dc = 1
    seen = set()

    while (r, c, dr, dc) not in seen:
        seen.add((r, c, dr, dc))
        nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
        if not (0 <= nr < height and 0 <= nc < width):
            break

        if grid[nr][nc] == 2:
            # The left end of a red bar is transparent.
            if nc > 0 and grid[nr][nc - 1] == 2:
                dr = -dr
                continue
        elif grid[nr][nc] == 3 and dr > 0:
            # Rebound only at the right end of a green bar.
            if nc + 1 == width or grid[nr][nc + 1] != 3:
                dr = -dr
                continue

        out[nr][nc] = 1
        r, c = nr, nc

    return out
